The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: Email Event ASIM filtering parser for Proofpoint POD message inspection
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime:datetime=datetime(null),
    endtime:datetime=datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailfromaddress_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailrecipient_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emailsubject_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildirection_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    emaildeliverylocation_in:dynamic=dynamic([]),
    eventresult:string="*",
    disabled:bool=false,
    pack:bool=false
) {
    let one_text = (v:dynamic) {
        case(gettype(v) == "string", tostring(v),
             gettype(v) == "array" and array_length(v) == 1 and gettype(v[0]) == "string", tostring(v[0]),
             "")
    };
    let string_array = (v:dynamic) {
        iff(gettype(v) == "array" and tostring(v) matches regex @'^\[\s*(?:"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"\s*(?:,\s*"(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*"\s*)*)?\]$', v, dynamic([]))
    };
    let email_domain = (address:string) {
        iff(address contains "@", tolower(tostring(split(address, "@")[-1])), "")
    };
    let spf_values = dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","softfail":"SoftFail","neutral":"Neutral","none":"None","temperror":"TemporaryError","permerror":"PermanentError"});
    let dkim_values = dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","none":"None","temperror":"TemporaryError","permerror":"PermanentError"});
    let dmarc_values = dynamic({"pass":"Pass","fail":"Fail","none":"None","bestguesspass":"BestGuessPass"});
    // Escape literal prefixes before joining them into a scalar IPv4/IPv6 filter.
    let escaped_prefixes = replace_regex(strcat_array(ipaddr_has_any_prefix, "\u001f"), @'([\\.^$|?*+(){}\[\]])', @'\\\1');
    let prefix_pattern = strcat("(?i)^(?:", replace_string(escaped_prefixes, "\u001f", "|"), ")");
    ProofpointPODMessage_CL
    | where not(disabled)
    | where isnull(starttime) or eventTime >= starttime
    | where isnull(endtime) or eventTime <= endtime
    | extend
        AdditionalFields = iff(pack, pack_all(), dynamic({})),
        EventStartTime = todatetime(eventTime),
        EventOriginalUid = tostring(guid),
        EmailFromAddress = one_text(msg.parsedAddresses.from),
        EmailMailFromAddress = tostring(envelope.from),
        EmailToRecipients = string_array(msg.parsedAddresses.['to']),
        EmailCCRecipients = string_array(msg.parsedAddresses.cc),
        EmailBCCRecipients = string_array(msg.parsedAddresses.bcc),
        EmailSubject = one_text(msg.normalizedHeader.subject),
        _ReplyTo = one_text(msg.normalizedHeader.['reply-to']),
        _ClientIp = tostring(connection.ip),
        _ClientHost = tolower(tostring(connection.host)),
        Dvc = coalesce(tostring(pps.agent), tostring(metadata.origin.data.agent), "Proofpoint On Demand Email Security"),
        DvcOriginalAction = tostring(['filter'].disposition),
        _Direction = tolower(tostring(['filter'].routeDirection)),
        _Protocol = toupper(tostring(split(tostring(connection.protocol), ":")[0])),
        _Size = tolong(msg.sizeBytes),
        _Dkim = iff(array_length(['filter'].modules.dkimv) == 1, ['filter'].modules.dkimv[0], dynamic(null)),
        EmailSpfOriginalResult = tostring(['filter'].modules.spf.result),
        EmailDmarcOriginalResult = tostring(['filter'].modules.dmarc.filterdResult)
    | where array_length(emailfromaddress_has_any) == 0 or EmailFromAddress has_any (emailfromaddress_has_any)
    | where array_length(emailsubject_has_any) == 0 or EmailSubject has_any (emailsubject_has_any)
    | where array_length(emailrecipient_has_any) == 0
        or tostring(EmailToRecipients) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
        or tostring(EmailCCRecipients) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
        or tostring(EmailBCCRecipients) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
        or tostring(envelope.rcpts) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
    | extend
        SrcIpAddr = iff(isnotempty(parse_ipv6(_ClientIp)), _ClientIp, ""),
        EmailReplyToAddress = trim(" ", iff(_ReplyTo contains "<", tostring(split(tostring(split(_ReplyTo, "<")[1]), ">")[0]), _ReplyTo)),
        EmailSizeBytes = iff(_Size >= 0, _Size, long(null)),
        EmailLanguage = tostring(msg.lang),
        EmailProtocolName = iff(_Protocol in ("SMTP", "IMAP", "POP3"), _Protocol, ""),
        EmailDirection = case(_Direction == "inbound", "Inbound", _Direction == "outbound", "Outbound",
                              _Direction == "internal", "Internal", _Direction == "local", "Local", "Unknown"),
        DvcAction = case(tolower(DvcOriginalAction) == "reject", "Blocked",
                         tolower(DvcOriginalAction) == "quarantine", "Quarantined",
                         tolower(DvcOriginalAction) == "discard", "Deleted", "NA"),
        EmailDeliveryLocation = iff(tolower(DvcOriginalAction) == "quarantine", "Quarantine", ""),
        DvcScopeId = coalesce(tostring(pps.cid), tostring(metadata.origin.data.cid)),
        EventProductVersion = coalesce(tostring(pps.version), tostring(metadata.origin.data.version)),
        SrcGeoCountry = toupper(tostring(connection.country)),
        EmailDkimOriginalResult = tostring(_Dkim.result),
        EmailDkimDomain = tostring(_Dkim.domain)
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or (isnotempty(SrcIpAddr) and SrcIpAddr matches regex prefix_pattern)
    | where array_length(emaildirection_in) == 0 or EmailDirection in~ (emaildirection_in)
    | where array_length(emaildeliverylocation_in) == 0 or EmailDeliveryLocation in~ (emaildeliverylocation_in)
    | where eventresult == "*" or eventresult =~ "NA"
    | extend
        EmailFromDomain = email_domain(EmailFromAddress),
        EmailMailFromDomain = email_domain(EmailMailFromAddress),
        EmailReplyToDomain = email_domain(EmailReplyToAddress),
        EmailSpfResult = tostring(spf_values[tolower(EmailSpfOriginalResult)]),
        EmailDkimResult = tostring(dkim_values[tolower(EmailDkimOriginalResult)]),
        EmailDmarcResult = tostring(dmarc_values[tolower(EmailDmarcOriginalResult)]),
        Dst = coalesce(one_text(envelope.rcpts[0]), tostring(EmailToRecipients[0]), tostring(EmailCCRecipients[0]), tostring(EmailBCCRecipients[0])),
        _ReportingFqdn = iff(Dvc contains "." and isempty(parse_ipv6(Dvc)), tolower(Dvc), ""),
        _SourceFqdn = iff(_ClientHost contains "." and isempty(parse_ipv6(_ClientHost)), _ClientHost, "")
    | extend
        DvcFQDN = _ReportingFqdn,
        DvcHostname = iff(isnotempty(_ReportingFqdn), tostring(split(_ReportingFqdn, ".")[0]), ""),
        DvcDomain = iff(isnotempty(_ReportingFqdn), substring(_ReportingFqdn, indexof(_ReportingFqdn, ".") + 1), ""),
        DvcDomainType = iff(isnotempty(_ReportingFqdn), "FQDN", ""),
        SrcFQDN = _SourceFqdn,
        SrcHostname = iff(isnotempty(_SourceFqdn), tostring(split(_SourceFqdn, ".")[0]), ""),
        SrcDomain = iff(isnotempty(_SourceFqdn), substring(_SourceFqdn, indexof(_SourceFqdn, ".") + 1), ""),
        SrcDomainType = iff(isnotempty(_SourceFqdn), "FQDN", ""),
        EventMessage = strcat(
            iff(isnull(EventStartTime), "Missing or invalid source eventTime; ", ""),
            iff(isempty(Dst), "Missing destination; ", ""),
            iff(isnotempty(_ClientIp) and isempty(SrcIpAddr), "Invalid source IP; ", ""),
            iff(array_length(msg.parsedAddresses.from) > 1, "Multiple header authors left unmapped; ", ""),
            iff(array_length(['filter'].modules.dkimv) > 1, "Multiple DKIM signatures retained only in packed source; ", ""),
            iff(gettype(msg.parsedAddresses.['to']) == "array" and array_length(msg.parsedAddresses.['to']) != array_length(EmailToRecipients), "Malformed To recipient array; ", ""),
            iff(gettype(msg.parsedAddresses.cc) == "array" and array_length(msg.parsedAddresses.cc) != array_length(EmailCCRecipients), "Malformed Cc recipient array; ", ""),
            iff(gettype(msg.parsedAddresses.bcc) == "array" and array_length(msg.parsedAddresses.bcc) != array_length(EmailBCCRecipients), "Malformed Bcc recipient array; ", ""),
            iff(isnotempty(EmailSpfOriginalResult) and isempty(EmailSpfResult), "Unknown SPF result; ", ""),
            iff(isnotempty(EmailDkimOriginalResult) and isempty(EmailDkimResult), "Unknown DKIM result; ", ""),
            iff(isnotempty(EmailDmarcOriginalResult) and isempty(EmailDmarcResult), "Unknown DMARC result; ", ""),
            iff(isnotempty(DvcOriginalAction) and tolower(DvcOriginalAction) !in ("continue", "reject", "quarantine", "discard"), "Unrecognized disposition; ", ""))
    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type = "ProofpointPODMessage_CL",
        EventStartTime, EventEndTime = EventStartTime, EventCount = int(1),
        EventSchema = "EmailEvent", EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventType = "EmailInspection", EventResult = "NA",
        EventVendor = "Proofpoint", EventProduct = "Proofpoint On Demand Email Security",
        EventProductVersion, EventOriginalUid, EventUid = EventOriginalUid, EventMessage,
        Dvc, DvcFQDN, DvcHostname, DvcDomain, DvcDomainType, DvcScopeId,
        DvcAction, DvcOriginalAction, DvcEntityKey = "",
        EmailFromAddress, EmailFromDomain, EmailMailFromAddress, EmailMailFromDomain,
        EmailReplyToAddress, EmailReplyToDomain, EmailToRecipients, EmailCCRecipients, EmailBCCRecipients,
        EmailSubject, EmailLanguage, EmailSizeBytes, EmailDirection, EmailDeliveryLocation, EmailProtocolName,
        EmailSpfOriginalResult, EmailSpfResult, EmailDkimOriginalResult, EmailDkimResult, EmailDkimDomain,
        EmailDmarcOriginalResult, EmailDmarcResult,
        SrcIpAddr, IpAddr = SrcIpAddr, Src = coalesce(SrcIpAddr, SrcFQDN),
        SrcFQDN, SrcHostname, SrcDomain, SrcDomainType, SrcGeoCountry, Dst,
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]), AdditionalFields
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix, emailfromaddress_has_any=emailfromaddress_has_any, emailrecipient_has_any=emailrecipient_has_any, emailsubject_has_any=emailsubject_has_any, emaildirection_in=emaildirection_in, emaildeliverylocation_in=emaildeliverylocation_in, eventresult=eventresult, disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
